principles.title: Your data is yours
principles.lead: impact log stores notes about your work, so privacy and security matter more to us than convenience. Here we explain, honestly and in detail, what guides us, what we store and how.

minimal.title: Minimal data
minimal.text: An account needs only a login and a password. We don’t ask for your email, phone or name, and we don’t try to find out who you are.

yours.title: Your data belongs to you
yours.text: Your entries are yours. We use them for nothing but showing them to you, and we’ll provide full export and full deletion.

secure.title: Secure by default
secure.text: Two-factor protection is mandatory for everyone, passwords are stored only as hashes, everything travels over HTTPS.

noTracking.title: No tracking
noTracking.text: No analytics, no trackers, no third-party scripts, no ads. We don’t know what you click and don’t want to.

honest.title: Honest about limits
honest.text: If something isn’t there yet, we say so. Any change in how we handle data will appear on this page.

stored.title: What we store and how
stored.lead: The complete list. If it isn’t here, we don’t store it.

login.how: The nickname you chose at sign-up. Used to sign in.

password.how: Only an Argon2id hash. We don’t know your password and can’t recover it.

totp.how: The secret for app codes is stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM). The encryption key is kept separately from the database.

recovery.how: 10 one-time codes. We store only their SHA-256 hashes and whether they were used.

sessions.how: A random token in a cookie with HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Strict flags. The database keeps only the token hash and expiry: a day and until the browser closes, or 30 days if you chose “Remember this computer”.

entries.how: Coming soon: notes on your work, tags, projects. Stored in the database on our server and accessible only to your account. Not end-to-end encrypted yet — technically the server administrator can access them; we are considering end-to-end encryption.

logs.how: Time, request method and path, response code and a truncated IP address (last octet zeroed). No headers, cookies or request bodies. Logs are rotated and kept briefly.

locale.how: Stored only in your browser (localStorage) and never sent anywhere.

trustedDevices.how: If you chose “Remember this computer”, a random token (cookie) is stored in your browser and only its hash and expiry (30 days) in our database. No 2FA code is asked on that device, the password always is. No browser fingerprints, IPs or device names. “Sign out everywhere” resets all trusted devices.

location.title: Server in Russia
location.text: All data lives on a single server in a data center in Moscow. No cloud data-processing services.

transport.title: Secure connection
transport.text: HTTPS only with HSTS, a strict content security policy (CSP) and rate-limited sign-in attempts.

alpha.title: Alpha stage
alpha.text: The service is under active development. Regular database backups are being set up — for now, don’t keep anything here you can’t afford to lose.
